dedupe_keys.name: cert lv cyber incident statistics latvia monthly and quarterly counts of handled incidents and warnings by category and severity

description: CERT.LV, Latvia's national IT security incident response institution, publishes statistics on the cyber threats it registers as monthly and quarterly posts under Incidents, Statistics; the latest listed on 2026-09-28 covered July 2026 (published 2026-08-21) and the second quarter of 2026. Since 1 January 2025 the statistics count unique cyber incidents handled manually by CERT.LV specialists, such as fraud or malware campaigns reported by people, institutions or companies, and the warnings sent through internet service providers to users about threats on their devices. Incidents and warnings are shown by threat category and placed in the UK NCSC threat matrix, a heatmap that combines impact and the significance of the affected body into severity classes C1 (national level, essential services affected) to C6 (everyday threats). Coverage is national, for Latvia. Format and access: charts and text in web posts, in Latvian, free to read; no tables or download were seen. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the change of method in 2025 may limit comparison with earlier years, and the figures are charts, not machine-readable data. Simulation uses: base rates and severity mixes of cyber incidents for cyber threat scenarios in telecom and critical infrastructure resilience studies. Related records: comparable to the Swiss BACS cyber incident statistics.
